description.en: Deeply connected to the earth, a virgo takes decisions according to analytical reasoning and practical considerations. Striving for meaningfulness in life, this star sign has an authentic and strong character. This pendant is available in 18 karat gold and sterling silver. Dimensions: approximately 21 x 15 x 2 mm.
